What the 527 files can and cannot support

Source: R/md-sources.R
md_irs527_shape.Rd

Measured on the 2024-11 vintage, before writing any ingest against them.

Form 8871 (irs527)

68,365 rows over 51,542 distinct EINs - so the key is FORM_ID_NUMBER (68,365 distinct, exactly the row count), not EIN. Each amendment is a new row, which is why the file carries name variants at all: 1,231 EINs (2.4%) appear under more than one organisation name. Ingest is therefore filing-level for name/address and deduplicated to EIN for entity.

EIN quality is perfect - all 68,365 are already bare 9-digit strings, none blank. Notably better than meta_names, whose EIN2 is EIN-00-0019818.

The file carries four address blocks (mailing, business, custodian, contact) and two person-name fields. CUSTODIAN_NAME and CONTACT_PERSON_NAME are legitimate in_care_of variants - an organisation genuinely written as "c/o " is a spelling the matcher should know. E_MAIL_ADDRESS should not be ingested: it carries no matching signal and is personal contact data with no purpose in a disambiguation reference.

Schedule R (irs527_related)

62,153 rows over 8,377 EINs - only 16% of 527s file one. Three findings shape how it can be used, and two of them are restrictive:

  1. The related entity has no EIN. The file gives (527 EIN) -> (ENTITY_NAME, address). ein_relation as specified in PLAN.md §4 is (ein_a, ein_b); this source cannot populate ein_b. Resolving a name to an EIN is a matching problem, which is npmatch's job, not matchdb's - so these rows land with ein_b NULL and the counterparty recorded by name, or they wait.

  2. Most related entities are not nonprofits. Only 1,102 of 10,597 distinct ENTITY_NAME values match a known 8871 organisation name - about 10%. The rest are sponsoring corporations, unions and trade associations, largely outside the BMF universe entirely.

  3. ENTITY_RELATIONSHIP is free text, not an enumeration. 528 distinct values. Connected (54,660) and Affiliated (5,801) are 97.4% of rows, with a long tail running to Mother, Indirect Control and Common candidate-CA 33rd Assembly Dist.. Any mapping onto the ein_relation.relation enum has to be explicit and has to say what it does with the tail.

Referential integrity to the 8871 file is close but not exact: 15,095 of 15,285 FORM_ID_NUMBER values resolve, leaving 190 orphans (1.2%).

What must not happen

The related entity's name must never be registered as a name variant on the 527's EIN. PLAN.md §10 is explicit that affiliates are not DBAs, and this is the case that most invites the error - "ASSOCIATION OF SAFETY GROUPS" is a different body from "ASGM PAC", and aliasing them would manufacture exactly the false matches the disambiguation database exists to prevent.

An ingest hazard

data.table::fread() segfaults on the 8871 file; utils::read.csv() reads it cleanly. The data is not malformed - line count and row count agree, so there are no embedded newlines. Ingest should not assume fread on these.
